recipes.title: Shape correspondence across categories
Dual reading through a concrete cue
recipes.operation: Keep a familiar phrase intact while a concrete domain cue activates its second natural meaning.
essentials: A phrase with two natural readings
a specific cue for the less immediate reading
a meaningful connection to the wearer
recipes.fit_failure: Fails when the second meaning requires an explanation or the image merely decorates the phrase.
recipes.illustration: A gardener calls a packet of seeds a growth plan; the financial and literal readings must both be familiar.

recipes.title: Sound substitution with a matching scene
recipes.operation: Change a small sound segment in a familiar expression and make the substituted meaning visible.
essentials: a scene or context that resolves the changed segment
recipes.fit_failure: Fits audiences familiar with the original phrase; fails if arbitrary spelling is doing all the work.
recipes.illustration: A repair hobbyist's weekend forecast replaces rain with a near-sounding tool term, if a natural phrase can be found; test recognition before drawing.

recipes.title: Harmless acronym re-expansion
recipes.operation: Preserve familiar initials but replace their expected expansion with a benign identity-specific one.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the abbreviation is unfamiliar or the expansion needs strained filler.
recipes.illustration: Re-expand a familiar workplace acronym into a natural hobby phrase; do not force words just to fill letters.

recipes.title: Literal creature inside a human idiom
recipes.operation: Depict the creature named in a figurative human label doing the relevant activity.
essentials: action or situation linking it back to the figurative meaning
recipes.fit_failure: An arbitrary animal mascot is insufficient; the language must motivate that animal.
recipes.illustration: A social butterfly conducts an actual conversation among flowers; audience and wording remain unvalidated.

recipes.title: Courtesy extended to unexpected residents
recipes.operation: Apply a familiar interpersonal norm to nonhuman beneficiaries.
essentials: visible reason that the beneficiary fits the rule's words
recipes.fit_failure: Fits nature or creature affinity; fails if a generic kindness slogan has no changed referent.
recipes.illustration: Give a garden's insects a visitor-welcome notice that treats them as the established community.

recipes.title: Noisy animal group as social proxy
recipes.operation: Map a group's recognizable vocal behavior to people repeatedly seeking one person's attention.
essentials: contextual cues establishing the human situation
recipes.fit_failure: Fails when animals merely wear uniforms without enacting the shared behavior.
recipes.illustration: Several alarm clocks all call for one household organizer; first test whether the proxy feels affectionate.

recipes.title: Word boundary becomes alternative route
recipes.operation: Split a word so part of it becomes an alternative within a familiar spatial idiom.
essentials: the split word creates a contrasting choice
recipes.fit_failure: A random hyphen or unrelated compound is insufficient.
recipes.illustration: Find a genuine word split that changes a familiar direction-giving phrase; no tested new application is claimed.

recipes.title: Supernatural power managed as routine administration
recipes.operation: Make an extraordinary future power subject to an ordinary planning habit.
essentials: that detail explains a personal motive
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the administrative object has no role in the fantasy.
recipes.illustration: A ghost maintains a calendar of tiny household hauntings; the planning detail must carry the joke.

recipes.title: Small habit defended as extreme necessity
recipes.operation: Treat a minor discomfort or habit as a matter of heroic endurance or survival.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails when stakes are actually severe or the exaggeration shames the audience.
recipes.illustration: A hobbyist describes waiting for glue to dry as an endurance event.

recipes.title: Occupational verb delivers an emotional result
recipes.operation: Replace the usual object of a job's defining verb with an emotional benefit.
essentials: abstract outcome occupying its object slot
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the emotional promise has no plausible relationship to the occupation.
recipes.illustration: A librarian shelves possibilities; test whether the action-to-benefit bridge is clear.

recipes.title: Reality evaluated using a hobby taxonomy
recipes.operation: Apply an enthusiast's classification system to everyday reality as a personal evaluation.
essentials: real-world referent outside its usual domain
judgment revealed by the category choice
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the label is just jargon with no changed evaluation.
recipes.illustration: A puzzle enthusiast calls a chaotic Monday an unsorted edge-piece day; familiarity must be checked.

recipes.title: Wrong species performs a signature animal ritual
recipes.operation: Preserve a recognizable animal ritual while replacing its normal performer.
recipes.fit_failure: Species-only substitutions within the same composition remain one commercial expression.
recipes.illustration: A creature with no migration habit follows an unmistakable migration formation; biological mismatch must be recognizable.

recipes.title: Leisure destination renamed as workplace
recipes.operation: Use a work-location announcement for a visibly recreational space.
essentials: a speaker who claims it as their working domain
recipes.fit_failure: Fails when the depicted place is actually the ordinary workplace.
recipes.illustration: A model-builder identifies the hobby bench as the day's branch office.

recipes.title: Affectionate honorary role
recipes.operation: Give ordinary competence or a valued family trait a compact unofficial title.
essentials: title that makes the combination legible
recipes.fit_failure: Fails when the title is merely a name or arbitrary noun pairing.
recipes.illustration: An enthusiastic family organizer receives an unofficial title grounded in one recognizable behavior.

recipes.title: Positive self-claim contradicted by the speaker
recipes.operation: Let a favorable verbal claim collide with visible evidence supplied by its speaker or favored subject.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the image and slogan can be read independently without changing meaning.
recipes.illustration: An immaculately calm declaration comes from a visibly tangled craft project.

recipes.title: Ordinary or tiny subject given epic agency
recipes.operation: Stage an ordinary role or small mild creature as the protagonist of an oversized heroic action.
recipes.fit_failure: A costume alone may be decorative; show agency or an event.
recipes.illustration: A tiny garden creature leads an expedition across a watering-can obstacle.

recipes.title: Apparent liability becomes cause of success
recipes.operation: Make a conventionally disqualifying trait the stated reason for a desirable outcome.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if it only celebrates the trait without showing the reversed cause.
recipes.illustration: A maker credits overthinking with a beautifully prepared repair; audience tone needs checking.

recipes.title: Body part treated as an independent social actor
recipes.operation: Give involuntary bodily expression a separate voice for which the wearer takes responsibility.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if simple personification has no interpersonal consequence.
recipes.illustration: Apologize on behalf of eyebrows that have already voted against a plan.

recipes.title: Sponsor credit applied to a natural dependency
recipes.operation: Use a sponsorship formula to identify the actual enabling source of a natural process.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the named source does not actually enable the process.
recipes.illustration: Credit a garden's growth to rain using a program-credit convention; verify the science.

recipes.title: Age reframed as productive preparation
recipes.operation: Treat elapsed years as craftsmanship, maturation or preparation for a valued present result.
essentials: recognized process that improves with time
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if it only prints a birth year without revaluing age.
recipes.illustration: Compare accumulated experience to a patiently developed craft finish, with a clear human mapping.

recipes.title: Garment placement identifies the reader
recipes.operation: Make the shirt's physical orientation establish who is being addressed or how they can respond.
essentials: message whose function depends on that position
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the same message works identically on an unrelated surface.
recipes.illustration: A back message offers a specific small assistance to the person behind; test consent and tone.

recipes.title: Extinct species makes a desired disappearance tangible
recipes.operation: Borrow extinction from vanished creatures to express a wish that a problem disappear.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if it implies a treatment claim or merely places a mascot beside a cause.
recipes.illustration: Use an extinct creature as an analogy for wishing a mundane obsolete annoyance would vanish.

recipes.title: Consumer flavor convention applied to incompatible goods
recipes.operation: Apply a familiar flavor or seasonal product convention to a category where it is absurd.
essentials: enough category cues for the collision
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the product could plausibly be an ordinary flavored item.
recipes.illustration: Give office supplies a seasonal tasting menu; avoid implying real product properties.

recipes.title: Political metaphor made physical
recipes.operation: Depict a political metaphor as its literal phenomenon while retaining the political instruction.
essentials: political cue that connects the readings
recipes.fit_failure: Color can be essential; removing it may erase the political meaning.
recipes.illustration: A civic message visualizes a familiar collective-action metaphor; do not imply measured electoral effects.

recipes.title: Dictionary entry justifies an informal reputation
recipes.operation: Use a dictionary entry to turn an affectionate fault into a favorable definition.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the definition merely repeats the word or the format is unreadable.
recipes.illustration: Define a hobbyist's fussiness as precision in a mock entry.

recipes.title: Misbehavior excuse normalized through an extreme scene
recipes.operation: Apply a familiar indulgent excuse to a conspicuously more extreme or unexpected behavior.
essentials: scene that makes the escalation apparent
recipes.fit_failure: Different causal scenes can be distinct expressions; changing only the animal in an identical scene is cosmetic.
recipes.illustration: Treat a group's elaborate harmless hobby ritual as an entirely ordinary habit.

recipes.title: Animal ability transferred into a human sport
recipes.operation: Turn a familiar bodily capability into competent performance of a human activity.
essentials: coordinated action rather than prop placement
recipes.fit_failure: Fails when a pet simply stands next to sporting equipment.
recipes.illustration: A balancing animal performs an unmistakable balancing task; anatomy must make the relation readable.

recipes.title: Second message hidden by selective typography
recipes.operation: Embed a second readable sequence inside innocent cover text by changing selected letters.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if letters must be rearranged without a clue or the cover text is meaningless.
recipes.illustration: Hide a short encouraging word inside a natural list; test at shirt-viewing scale.

recipes.title: Rule sequence broken by an unbeatable identity
recipes.operation: Establish a familiar competitive sequence, then insert the audience's group as an impossible winner.
essentials: unexpected entrant that overrides those rules
recipes.fit_failure: Fails without rule recognition or if the final group is merely appended.
recipes.illustration: A familiar game sequence ends with a household pet that ignores every rule.

recipes.title: Herd animal replaced inside a working scene
recipes.operation: Preserve a recognizable collective task while substituting an unexpected herd.
recipes.fit_failure: A single costumed pet is insufficient; the collective task must survive.
recipes.illustration: A shepherd manages a flock of windblown household objects; make the action clear.

recipes.title: Life transition expands a privileged time category
recipes.operation: Make a change in status extend an occasional desirable interval to every day.
essentials: universal expansion supported by the status
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if it is merely a generic celebration of leisure.
recipes.illustration: A finished project turns every scheduled check-in into free time; validate whether the audience shares the premise.

recipes.title: Organization founded on avoiding its own activity
recipes.operation: Give a social institution a membership trait that undermines the institution's normal function.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the club is only a hobby label without a contradiction.
recipes.illustration: A meeting club whose proudest achievement is canceling meetings.

recipes.title: Cute creature causes disproportionate destruction
recipes.operation: Combine a harmless-looking subject with unmistakably excessive destructive power.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the scene is merely a large animal or ordinary mischievous pet.
recipes.illustration: A tiny creature accidentally topples an enormous imaginary snack structure; retain a readable cause.

recipes.title: Mundane substitute approximates a magical feature
recipes.operation: Use a cheap object with the right geometry to approximate a mythical defining feature.
essentials: shared shape between substitute and missing feature
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the object is unrelated in silhouette or simply worn as a costume.
recipes.illustration: An ordinary tool becomes a makeshift fantasy attribute through an actual shape correspondence.

recipes.title: Expected adversaries exchange a tender gesture
recipes.operation: Replace the expected behavior of an imposing figure or confrontation with a tiny gentle action.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if tenderness is inferred only from the caption.
recipes.illustration: An enormous imaginary guard carefully shelters a tiny seedling.

recipes.title: Helpful promise ends in counterproductive result
recipes.operation: Begin with an implied offer of help and reveal that the helper predictably worsens or narrows the solution.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the ending is unrelated surprise.
recipes.illustration: A repair-advice offer always turns into permission to start another project.

recipes.title: Broad welcome narrowed by a late restriction
recipes.operation: Establish a broad inclination and then sharply restrict its object.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails when the second clause only adds information without changing the opening.
recipes.illustration: An enthusiastic social declaration ends with a tiny explicitly bounded audience.

recipes.title: Attractive invitation followed by a dark shared-location qualifier
recipes.operation: Undercut a positive invitation with a negative possibility attached to the same setting.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the warning has no relationship to the setup.
recipes.illustration: A tempting adventure invitation ends with an ordinary but unwelcome logistical reality.

recipes.title: Apology revealed as a non-excuse
recipes.operation: Use the expected apology scaffold but admit an avoidable, freely chosen cause.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the reason actually excuses the behavior.
recipes.illustration: An apology for delay ends with a confession of admiring an interesting window display.

recipes.title: Sage quotation collapses into blunt departure
recipes.operation: Promise wisdom through attribution and deliver a short colloquial exit.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the quote is simply inspirational.
recipes.illustration: A ceremonially attributed statement ends with a mundane decision to go home.

recipes.title: Late purchase reveal changes who is speaking
recipes.operation: End apparent self-praise or relationship praise by revealing who supplied the statement.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the gift origin has no effect on the claim.
recipes.illustration: A boast about impeccable taste ends by crediting the person who chose the shirt.

recipes.title: Consumer review judges a social abstraction
recipes.operation: Apply a product-rating convention to an entity not ordinarily reviewed as a purchasable item.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if stars are decorative or the subject is an ordinary product.
recipes.illustration: Rate a familiar recurring inconvenience using a legible review convention.

recipes.title: Certificate declares release from obligation
recipes.operation: Use formal status recognition to authorize a personal exemption.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if it only states the milestone.
recipes.illustration: A completion certificate formally releases its holder from one humorous project obligation.

recipes.title: Natural habit exploits fantasy anatomy
recipes.operation: Let an ordinary action produce an unexpected consequence because a fantasy body has different properties.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the parts are simply rearranged without cause.
recipes.illustration: A routine tug detaches a replaceable fantasy component; depict cause and result together.

recipes.title: Mundane mission delivered as a martial rally
recipes.operation: Give an ordinary shared activity the urgency and ceremony of a campaign.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails when there is no everyday task to contrast with the grandeur.
recipes.illustration: A repair group assembles at dawn for a very small household fix.

recipes.title: Pet defiance cast as political resistance
recipes.operation: Describe ordinary pet resistance using grand autonomy language.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the pet is only posing beside a slogan.
recipes.illustration: A small creature refuses one trivial household instruction with revolutionary solemnity.

recipes.title: Hobby subject becomes its own observer
recipes.operation: Make the normal object of a hobby perform the hobby itself.
essentials: tools or action that establish the loop
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the animal simply holds an arbitrary object.
recipes.illustration: A model miniature carefully inspects a miniature collection.

recipes.title: Anatomy gives an activity advantage
recipes.operation: Choose a creature whose distinctive anatomy makes a human task unusually possible.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the special anatomy contributes nothing.
recipes.illustration: A many-limbed creature performs a task with simultaneous distinct actions.

recipes.title: Imposing fantasy figure enjoys a quiet human pastime
recipes.operation: Give a threatening or elusive figure an unexpectedly ordinary private hobby.
essentials: visible contradiction in scale or temperament
recipes.fit_failure: Fails with an arbitrary mascot lacking a relevant reputation.
recipes.illustration: An intimidating imaginary guardian becomes absorbed in a tiny puzzle.

recipes.title: Abstract self-management shown as a literal trip
recipes.operation: Treat an internal task as a physical destination with transportation.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if movement is just incidental decoration.
recipes.illustration: A character physically sets off to find its patience; test whether the phrase naturally supports travel.

recipes.title: Imagined beneficiaries justify a familiar institution
recipes.operation: Extend a real protective institution to fantasy beneficiaries.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if fantasy imagery is merely decorative branding.
recipes.illustration: A conservation-style message protects imaginary miniature habitats.

recipes.title: Historical authority imagined responding today
recipes.operation: Invoke a known historical role and imply its characteristic response to current behavior.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if understanding requires invented history.
recipes.illustration: An imagined historical craft inspector comments on a modern everyday shortcut; verify the premise.

recipes.title: Absurd explanation for a known outcome
recipes.operation: Explain an established outcome with a clearly comic false cause.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if it could be mistaken for an unsupported factual explanation.
recipes.illustration: Attribute a mundane object's disappearance to its exaggerated emotional reaction.

recipes.title: Nuisance reinterpreted as technical competence
recipes.operation: Assign expert intent to behavior normally considered an annoyance.
essentials: technical discipline that resembles its action
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the expertise has no operational connection.
recipes.illustration: A pet's repetitive disruption is framed as testing one recognizable physical principle.

recipes.title: Bent grammar escalates an attitude
recipes.operation: Apply a recognizable grammatical escalation where standard grammar does not permit it.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if spelling errors are random.
recipes.illustration: Escalate a familiar refusal through a deliberately impossible comparative form.

recipes.title: Affectionate award for an everyday mishap
recipes.operation: Turn a small recurring flaw into a ceremonial group superlative.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails when the label humiliates rather than recognizes.
recipes.illustration: Give a small harmless travel mishap a mock best-in-group award.

recipes.title: Warning format announces harmless indulgence
recipes.operation: Borrow a caution convention to announce a familiar group's ordinary indulgence.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the supposed threat is actually serious.
recipes.illustration: A caution sign announces that a hobby group has found another supply sale.

recipes.title: Mock feature advertisement sells an unexpected organism
recipes.operation: Pitch a creature's genuine unusual traits as product specifications.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if it invents traits or is merely a labeled animal.
recipes.illustration: Present a familiar organism's verified capacities as an absurd appliance specification.

recipes.title: Charged role softened into a benign activity
recipes.operation: Apply a socially charged role or process to an innocuous prosocial behavior.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the term is just provocation without a new interpretation.
recipes.illustration: Describe ordinary snack-sharing with an exaggerated underground-distribution role.

recipes.title: Category substitution makes an enthusiasm tangible
recipes.operation: Put a beloved season or experience into a category it is not literally a member of.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if there is no plausible sensory or emotional bridge.
recipes.illustration: Call a familiar place one's preferred flavor only if the design establishes the sensory bridge.

recipes.title: Stopping framed as an undesirable character trait
recipes.operation: Recast the object or act that limits indulgence as a failure of commitment.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the connection to stopping is unclear or tone endorses harmful excess.
recipes.illustration: A harmless hobby's packing-away box is framed as a surrender device.

recipes.title: Innocent object resolves apparent adult meaning
recipes.operation: Lead toward a charged interpretation then show a literal harmless referent.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the harmless reading is strained.
recipes.illustration: Use a naturally ambiguous household term whose literal object clearly resolves the tease.

recipes.title: Animal speaker reveals a darker stake
recipes.operation: Let the chosen animal turn an ordinary waiting question into a species-specific motive.
essentials: inferred motive tied to the species
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if species choice contributes no motive.
recipes.illustration: A creature waits politely for an event that would benefit its known feeding habit.

recipes.title: Low-energy persona contradicts a theatrical costume
recipes.operation: Combine an expressive seasonal role with a conspicuously unimpressed ordinary persona.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the animal's affect is unreadable.
recipes.illustration: An ostensibly fearsome costume is worn with unmistakable reluctance.

recipes.title: Charged boast ends in impossible means
recipes.operation: Begin a provocative familiar boast and reveal an anatomically incompatible means of achieving it.
essentials: incompatibility that changes the initial reading
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if shock alone supplies the effect or the final clause is unrelated.
recipes.illustration: A non-explicit boast about manual skill ends by assigning the work to an impossible body part; test legibility.

recipes.title: Aspiration literalized through physical failure
recipes.operation: Turn a figurative path of good conduct into literal motion and interrupt it with an everyday mishap.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the fall is unrelated slapstick.
recipes.illustration: A metaphor for steady progress becomes a literal stumble over a small ordinary obstacle.

recipes.title: Expressive animal externalizes human bewilderment
recipes.operation: Let an animal's readable gesture enact a familiar human reaction.
recipes.fit_failure: Fails if the expression is neutral or the caption contradicts it without a reason.
recipes.illustration: An unmistakably perplexed creature responds to a recognizable minor everyday puzzle.
